AS5048B I2C Address (64, 65, 66, 67)
--------------------------------------------------
64 ---> 0x40 (A2: NC / GND, A1: NC / GND) ... Default
65 ---> 0x41 (A2: GND,      A1: 5V / 3.3V)
66 ---> 0x42 (A2: 5V / 3.3V, A1: GND)
67 ---> 0x43 (A2: 5V / 3.3V, A1: 5V / 3.3V)
